# Class index

Every class in the production code, A to Z. Each name links to its entry in its system's reference; the system links to its overview. 207 classes.

| Class | System | Extends | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| [AbilityBase](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#abilitybase) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | Node | One thing a pawn can do, such as walk, jump, swing or dash: a child of the pawn's [AbilityManager]. |
| [AbilityCondition](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#abilitycondition) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | Resource | A condition a step timeline entry can start on: one value of the pawn compared with a number (ability spec 6.3). |
| [AbilityDefinition](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#abilitydefinition) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | Definition | The settings one variant of an ability has, shared by every pawn that uses it, such as "Goblin Swing": a Resource an ability node points at (ability spec 3). |
| [AbilityManager](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#abilitymanager) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | Node | Starts, runs and stops a pawn's abilities, and takes the hits that land on it. |
| [AbilityModifier](../assets/scripts/effects/REFERENCE.md#abilitymodifier) | [effects](../assets/scripts/effects/README.md) | EffectModifier | Changes one of a group of abilities' priority numbers while its effect lasts. A modifier ([EffectModifier]). |
| [AbilityStep](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#abilitystep) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | Step | One step of an ability, such as a windup, a turn or a swing: a child node of the ability, run by its [StepTimeline]. |

| [AIAttackBehaviour](../assets/scripts/ai/REFERENCE.md#aiattackbehaviour) | [ai](../assets/scripts/ai/README.md) | AIBehaviourBase | Attacks the current target once it's close enough: a swing, a shot, any attack on its action. |
| [AIAttackDefinition](../assets/scripts/ai/REFERENCE.md#aiattackdefinition) | [ai](../assets/scripts/ai/README.md) | AIBehaviourDefinition | The settings of a Attack behaviour ([AIAttackBehaviour]), shared by every pawn whose Attack uses it. |
| [AIAwarenessState](../assets/scripts/ai/REFERENCE.md#aiawarenessstate) | [ai](../assets/scripts/ai/README.md) | AIStateBase | One tunable state for every "how aware am I of an enemy" situation, such as Alert and Combat. |

| [NavMarkerDebugModule](../assets/scripts/navigation/REFERENCE.md#navmarkerdebugmodule) | [navigation](../assets/scripts/navigation/README.md) | NavMarkerModule | Draws every nav marker while the game runs (nav spec 21.4). |
| [NavMarkerModule](../assets/scripts/navigation/REFERENCE.md#navmarkermodule) | [navigation](../assets/scripts/navigation/README.md) | Node | The base for code that acts on nav markers (nav spec 21.4). |
| [NavMarkerNode](../assets/scripts/navigation/REFERENCE.md#navmarkernode) | [navigation](../assets/scripts/navigation/README.md) | Node3D | Places a nav marker by hand in a scene (nav spec 21.5). |
| [NavObstacle](../assets/scripts/navigation/REFERENCE.md#navobstacle) | [navigation](../assets/scripts/navigation/README.md) | NavMarker | Something that doesn't navigate but affects paths: a dynamic obstacle, such as a crate or a fallen tree (nav spec 11 and 21.3). |
| [NavPoint](../assets/scripts/navigation/REFERENCE.md#navpoint) | [navigation](../assets/scripts/navigation/README.md) | NavMarker | A spot that means something to AI: a tactical point or point of interest (nav spec 21.3). |
| [NavSmartObject](../assets/scripts/navigation/REFERENCE.md#navsmartobject) | [navigation](../assets/scripts/navigation/README.md) | NavPoint | A point AI can use, with room for a limited number of users (nav spec 21.3). |
| [NetClock](../assets/scripts/netcode/REFERENCE.md#netclock) | [netcode](../assets/scripts/netcode/README.md) | RefCounted | A client's estimate of the server's clock (netcode spec section 4). |
| [NetPackets](../assets/scripts/netcode/REFERENCE.md#netpackets) | [netcode](../assets/scripts/netcode/README.md) | RefCounted | What goes on the wire (netcode spec section 11): packet types, and how one value is turned into bytes and back. |
| [NetworkEntity](../assets/scripts/netcode/REFERENCE.md#networkentity) | [netcode](../assets/scripts/netcode/README.md) | Node | Makes an entity exist across the network (netcode spec sections 7, 10, 13). |
| [NetworkSessionSingleton](../assets/scripts/singletons/REFERENCE.md#networksessionsingleton) | [singletons](../assets/scripts/singletons/README.md) | Node | The multiplayer session (autoload "NetworkSession"): connects machines, spawns entities on all of them, and moves inputs and snapshots between them. Offline it does nothing and entities play as single player. |
| [OpenComboStep](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#opencombostep) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | AbilityStep | Opens the combo window when it starts, so a follow-up can start for [member window_ticks]. |
| [OwnedTags](../assets/scripts/tags/REFERENCE.md#ownedtags) | [tags](../assets/scripts/tags/README.md) | Node | The tags a pawn owns right now, counted: what a [TagQuery] asks about ("is it in combat, dead, out of ammo?"). Tag spec 3. |
| [ParryAbility](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#parryability) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | AbilityBase | A parry stance: while it runs, a hit from the front does nothing to this pawn, and the attacker is pushed back instead. |
| [ParryDefinition](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#parrydefinition) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | AbilityDefinition | A parry's settings. |
| [ParryModifier](../assets/scripts/effects/REFERENCE.md#parrymodifier) | [effects](../assets/scripts/effects/README.md) | EffectModifier | Parrying: while its effect lasts, hits from the front are blocked and the attacker gets a reply. An [EffectModifier]. |
| [PathFollower](../assets/scripts/navigation/REFERENCE.md#pathfollower) | [navigation](../assets/scripts/navigation/README.md) | RefCounted | Follows one nav path for one pawn: finds it through NavServer, keeps its corners, and says which way to walk each tick. |
| [PathFollowSettings](../assets/scripts/navigation/REFERENCE.md#pathfollowsettings) | [navigation](../assets/scripts/navigation/README.md) | Resource | How a [PathFollower] follows its path: how close counts as there, which nav, links, and how long it waits for nav. |
| [Pawn](../assets/scripts/pawn/REFERENCE.md#pawn) | [pawn](../assets/scripts/pawn/README.md) | CharacterBody3D | A body something can possess, which runs its parts in a fixed order each tick. |
| [PawnDefaultsRes](../assets/scripts/resources/REFERENCE.md#pawndefaultsres) | [resources](../assets/scripts/resources/README.md) | Resource | The parts every pawn gets unless its own scene already has one of the same name, and other game-wide pawn settings. |
| [PawnInitializer](../assets/scripts/game_mode/REFERENCE.md#pawninitializer) | [game_mode](../assets/scripts/game_mode/README.md) | GameModeModule | Gives every pawn the parts it needs to work, from one list per game. |
| [PawnSpawner](../assets/scripts/spawning/REFERENCE.md#pawnspawner) | [spawning](../assets/scripts/spawning/README.md) | Node3D | Keeps a number of pawns of one type alive, replacing each that dies after a delay. |
| [PawnStreamingSource](../assets/scripts/streaming/REFERENCE.md#pawnstreamingsource) | [streaming](../assets/scripts/streaming/README.md) | StreamingSource | A pawn's streaming source: keeps the world loaded around its pawn while a player has it, or always with [member keeps_world_loaded] on (a hero). |
| [PerfScopes](../assets/scripts/diagnostics/REFERENCE.md#perfscopes) | [diagnostics](../assets/scripts/diagnostics/README.md) | RefCounted | Timing scopes: systems mark the work they do, and a diagnostics tool reads how long each took, frame by frame. |
| [PlayerCamera](../assets/scripts/camera/REFERENCE.md#playercamera) | [camera](../assets/scripts/camera/README.md) | Camera3D | The one real camera, which follows a VirtualCamera. PlayerController owns it. |
| [PlayerController](../assets/scripts/player/REFERENCE.md#playercontroller) | [player](../assets/scripts/player/README.md) | ControllerBase | One player's controls: reads their devices, aims their camera, and gives their pawn input. |
| [PossessionCoordinator](../assets/scripts/game_mode/REFERENCE.md#possessioncoordinator) | [game_mode](../assets/scripts/game_mode/README.md) | GameModeModule | Who controls which pawn: players possess and let go of pawns through here. |
| [PredictedProjectile](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#predictedprojectile) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | Node3D | The shooter's own client's copy of its projectile, drawn the moment it fires (ability spec 9): a visual, with no hits. |
| [Projectile](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#projectile) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | Node3D | A projectile in flight: a networked entity whose flight is worked out from its launch, hitting pawns (up to max_hits) and the ground. |
| [ProjectileDefinition](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#projectiledefinition) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | Definition | A projectile's flight, shared by every shot that uses it (ability spec 9): its speed and how it changes, how much it drops, its size, how far and long it flies, whether the world stops it, and its look. Who it may hit and what a hit does is its ability's [HitDefinition] (ability spec 13). |
| [ProjectileTraceView](../assets/scripts/diagnostics/REFERENCE.md#projectiletraceview) | [diagnostics](../assets/scripts/diagnostics/README.md) | Node3D | A debug view of projectiles on F5: each one's planned path, where it has flown, what it met and where it ended. |
| [RangedAttackAbility](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#rangedattackability) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | AbilityBase | A ranged attack: an action bound to &"primary" that fires a projectile, built from steps. |
| [RangedAttackDefinition](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#rangedattackdefinition) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | AbilityDefinition | A ranged attack's settings: its projectile, timings and muzzle. |
| [ReceiveHitAbility](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#receivehitability) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | AbilityBase | Taking a hit: an instant action, started by [code]event.hit.taken[/code], that decides what a hit does to its pawn (pawn spec 16.7). |
| [ReceiveHitDefinition](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#receivehitdefinition) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | AbilityDefinition | The hit ability's settings: the base ones, with its defaults. |
| [ReplayChannel](../assets/scripts/replay/REFERENCE.md#replaychannel) | [replay](../assets/scripts/replay/README.md) | RefCounted | The base for one kind of data in a replay file (replay spec section 3). |
| [ReplayDiagnosticsChannel](../assets/scripts/replay/REFERENCE.md#replaydiagnosticschannel) | [replay](../assets/scripts/replay/README.md) | ReplayEventChannel | Replay channel 6, "diagnostics": how each frame went, recorded alongside the game. |
| [ReplayEntityChannel](../assets/scripts/replay/REFERENCE.md#replayentitychannel) | [replay](../assets/scripts/replay/README.md) | ReplayChannel | A replay channel with one record per pawn (replay spec section 3). |
| [ReplayEventChannel](../assets/scripts/replay/REFERENCE.md#replayeventchannel) | [replay](../assets/scripts/replay/README.md) | ReplayChannel | A replay channel of events: things that happen at a moment (replay spec section 3). |
| [ReplayGameplayChannel](../assets/scripts/replay/REFERENCE.md#replaygameplaychannel) | [replay](../assets/scripts/replay/README.md) | ReplayEventChannel | Replay channel 5, "gameplay": what happened, as events. |
| [ReplayInputChannel](../assets/scripts/replay/REFERENCE.md#replayinputchannel) | [replay](../assets/scripts/replay/README.md) | ReplayEntityChannel | Replay channel 2, "input": each pawn's input command (replay spec section 1). |
| [ReplayMotionChannel](../assets/scripts/replay/REFERENCE.md#replaymotionchannel) | [replay](../assets/scripts/replay/README.md) | ReplayEntityChannel | Replay channel 1, "motion": where each pawn is and what it's doing (replay spec section 3). |
| [ReplayReader](../assets/scripts/replay/REFERENCE.md#replayreader) | [replay](../assets/scripts/replay/README.md) | RefCounted | Reads a replay file (docs/replay/REPLAY_SPEC.md) and gives the state at any tick. |
| [ReplayRecorder](../assets/scripts/replay/REFERENCE.md#replayrecorder) | [replay](../assets/scripts/replay/README.md) | GameModeModule | Records every pawn, every tick, to a replay file. |
| [ReplaySpawnChannel](../assets/scripts/replay/REFERENCE.md#replayspawnchannel) | [replay](../assets/scripts/replay/README.md) | ReplayEventChannel | Replay channel 3, "spawns": which pawns exist. |
| [ReplayViewer](../assets/scripts/replay/REFERENCE.md#replayviewer) | [replay](../assets/scripts/replay/README.md) | Node3D | Plays and scrubs a recording: ghost capsules for the pawns, outlines for the built chunks and the chunk sources' load distances. |
| [ReplayWorldChannel](../assets/scripts/replay/REFERENCE.md#replayworldchannel) | [replay](../assets/scripts/replay/README.md) | ReplayEventChannel | Replay channel 4, "world": the loaded ground and what keeps it loaded. |
| [ReplayWriter](../assets/scripts/replay/REFERENCE.md#replaywriter) | [replay](../assets/scripts/replay/README.md) | RefCounted | Writes a replay file on a thread of its own, so the game's ticks never wait for the disk. |
| [ResistanceModifier](../assets/scripts/effects/REFERENCE.md#resistancemodifier) | [effects](../assets/scripts/effects/README.md) | EffectModifier | Adds to the pawn's resistance to a kind of effect while its effect lasts. A modifier ([EffectModifier]). |
| [RunEnvironment](../assets/scripts/platform/REFERENCE.md#runenvironment) | [platform](../assets/scripts/platform/README.md) | RefCounted | Facts about where this run of the game is, asked in one place. So far: whether it has a display. |
| [ScriptOverrides](../assets/scripts/platform/REFERENCE.md#scriptoverrides) | [platform](../assets/scripts/platform/README.md) | RefCounted | Whether a script overrides a function of the script it extends: one place for a question several systems ask. |
| [SharedPawnTable](../assets/scripts/pawn/REFERENCE.md#sharedpawntable) | [pawn](../assets/scripts/pawn/README.md) | RefCounted | The one shared table of plain pawn data (the C++ PawnTable) and the grid built on it (AIPawnGrid), for AI sensing and swing hits. |
| [SightGeometryFeeder](../assets/scripts/ai/REFERENCE.md#sightgeometryfeeder) | [ai](../assets/scripts/ai/README.md) | RefCounted | Keeps the shared SightGeometry (line of sight in C++) fed with the solid things in the scene. |
| [SightSense](../assets/scripts/ai/REFERENCE.md#sightsense) | [ai](../assets/scripts/ai/README.md) | AISenseBase | Sight, for basic stealth: fills awareness of other-team pawns it can see, faster when they're close and in front. |
| [SpawnManager](../assets/scripts/game_mode/REFERENCE.md#spawnmanager) | [game_mode](../assets/scripts/game_mode/README.md) | GameModeModule | Puts pawns into the world at SpawnPoints, and brings players back after they die. |
| [SpawnPoint](../assets/scripts/spawning/REFERENCE.md#spawnpoint) | [spawning](../assets/scripts/spawning/README.md) | Node3D | A place where pawns can appear, like Unreal's PlayerStart. |
| [SprintAbility](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#sprintability) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | WalkAbility | Running faster while a charge lasts: a locomotion ability bound to &"sprint". |
| [SprintDefinition](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#sprintdefinition) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | WalkDefinition | Sprint's settings: Walk's, plus its charge. |
| [Stat](../assets/scripts/stats/REFERENCE.md#stat) | [stats](../assets/scripts/stats/README.md) | Node | One number about a pawn, such as how fast it walks. A child of the pawn's StatusManager. |
| [StatChangeEffector](../assets/scripts/effects/REFERENCE.md#statchangeeffector) | [effects](../assets/scripts/effects/README.md) | EffectEffector | Changes how much of a stat a pawn has, once: Health -20 is damage, Health +15 a heal. An effector ([EffectEffector]). |
| [StateEncoding](../assets/scripts/netcode/REFERENCE.md#stateencoding) | [netcode](../assets/scripts/netcode/README.md) | RefCounted | How precisely networked values are stored (netcode spec section 5.3). |
| [StateStoreGD](../assets/scripts/state_store/REFERENCE.md#statestoregd) | [state_store](../assets/scripts/state_store/README.md) | RefCounted | The GDScript twin of the C++ [code]StateStore[/code]: the central record of every gameplay entity's state, tick by tick. |
| [StatModifier](../assets/scripts/effects/REFERENCE.md#statmodifier) | [effects](../assets/scripts/effects/README.md) | EffectModifier | Changes a stat's value while its effect lasts, such as MoveSpeed x0.7 for a slow. A modifier ([EffectModifier]). |
| [StatThreshold](../assets/scripts/status/REFERENCE.md#statthreshold) | [status](../assets/scripts/status/README.md) | Resource | A level on a stat that sends an event when the stat's current value falls to it or below (pawn spec 16.8). |
| [StatusManager](../assets/scripts/status/REFERENCE.md#statusmanager) | [status](../assets/scripts/status/README.md) | Node | A pawn's status: its stats and the effects on it, in one component (pawn spec 16.8). |
| [Step](../assets/scripts/steps/REFERENCE.md#step) | [steps](../assets/scripts/steps/README.md) | Node | One step on a timeline, such as a windup, a turn or a swing: a child node of what owns the timeline (pawn spec 16.7). |
| [StepTimeline](../assets/scripts/steps/REFERENCE.md#steptimeline) | [steps](../assets/scripts/steps/README.md) | RefCounted | Runs an owner's [Step] children on a timeline of [TimelineEntry] rules (pawn spec 16.7, ability spec 6.2). |
| [StreamingSource](../assets/scripts/streaming/REFERENCE.md#streamingsource) | [streaming](../assets/scripts/streaming/README.md) | Node3D | Marks something as keeping the world loaded around it. |
| [SweepKey](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#sweepkey) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | Resource | One point on a swing's path: where the hit sphere is at one moment of the hit window (ability spec 7). |
| [TagDeclarationsRes](../assets/scripts/resources/REFERENCE.md#tagdeclarationsres) | [resources](../assets/scripts/resources/README.md) | Resource | A declarations file: the tags a game declares up front, each with a one-line description, plus renames and deprecations. |
| [TagQuery](../assets/scripts/tags/REFERENCE.md#tagquery) | [tags](../assets/scripts/tags/README.md) | Resource | A yes/no question about a pawn's owned tags: all of these, any of those, none of the others (tag spec 4). |
| [TagRegistry](../assets/scripts/tags/REFERENCE.md#tagregistry) | [tags](../assets/scripts/tags/README.md) | RefCounted | Every tag in the game: turns names like "ability.combat.melee" into bits, so checks are one AND instead of comparing text. |
| [Tags](../assets/scripts/tags/REFERENCE.md#tags) | [tags](../assets/scripts/tags/README.md) | RefCounted | The declared tags as named constants, grouped by category, so code can't misspell one. |
| [TeamRegistry](../assets/scripts/game_mode/REFERENCE.md#teamregistry) | [game_mode](../assets/scripts/game_mode/README.md) | GameModeModule | How many pawns are on each team, kept current as pawns enter and leave the tree and change team. |
| [TerrainBodyLifter](../assets/scripts/terrain/REFERENCE.md#terrainbodylifter) | [terrain](../assets/scripts/terrain/README.md) | Node | Moves bodies up onto the ground when an edit raises it above them. |
| [TerrainEditLog](../assets/scripts/terrain/REFERENCE.md#terraineditlog) | [terrain](../assets/scripts/terrain/README.md) | Node | Remembers every edit to a [TerrainGenerator], so a chunk built later still has them. |
| [TerrainGenerator](../assets/scripts/terrain/REFERENCE.md#terraingenerator) | [terrain](../assets/scripts/terrain/README.md) | Node3D | Generates ground in square chunks, with a low-poly look and no visible square grid. |
| [TerrainNavFeeder](../assets/scripts/world/REFERENCE.md#terrainnavfeeder) | [world](../assets/scripts/world/README.md) | Node | Feeds nav from a terrain generator, so that neither has to know the other exists. |
| [TerrainSettings](../assets/scripts/navigation/REFERENCE.md#terrainsettings) | [navigation](../assets/scripts/navigation/README.md) | RefCounted | Where a terrain is and how big its chunks are, as plain values (nav spec 21.6). |
| [TickDriverSingleton](../assets/scripts/singletons/REFERENCE.md#tickdriversingleton) | [singletons](../assets/scripts/singletons/README.md) | Node | Runs all gameplay in numbered, fixed-length ticks, online and offline. Autoload "TickDriver". |
| [TickJobs](../assets/scripts/jobs/REFERENCE.md#tickjobs) | [jobs](../assets/scripts/jobs/README.md) | RefCounted | Finds the one job scheduler every job kind shares (scaling spec section 4). |
| [TickScheduler](../assets/scripts/singletons/REFERENCE.md#tickscheduler) | [singletons](../assets/scripts/singletons/README.md) | RefCounted | Actions booked for a tick and a point in it, run in a fixed order (netcode spec 19.4, pawn spec 16.9). |
| [TickStateComponent](../assets/scripts/netcode/REFERENCE.md#tickstatecomponent) | [netcode](../assets/scripts/netcode/README.md) | Node | Makes an entity rollback-ready without writing code (netcode spec sections 5 and 6). |
| [TimelineEntry](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#timelineentry) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | Resource | One entry of an ability's step timeline: which step runs, the values it runs with, and when it starts (ability spec 6.2). |
| [ToyWaddle](../assets/scripts/visuals/REFERENCE.md#toywaddle) | [visuals](../assets/scripts/visuals/README.md) | Node3D | Makes a pawn's model move like a toy being played with: rocking, hopping, leaning into a dash and falling over when it dies. |
| [TurnToFaceStep](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#turntofacestep) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | AbilityStep | Turns the pawn toward where it looks, following the look as it moves, at the pawn's TurnRate stat. |
| [VirtualCamera](../assets/scripts/camera/REFERENCE.md#virtualcamera) | [camera](../assets/scripts/camera/README.md) | Node3D | A place for the real camera to be. |
| [VisualPlacementGD](../assets/scripts/pawn/REFERENCE.md#visualplacementgd) | [pawn](../assets/scripts/pawn/README.md) | RefCounted | Places every pawn's Visual between ticks, in one call a frame: the GDScript twin of the C++ VisualPlacement, used where that library isn't available. |
| [VisualPlacer](../assets/scripts/pawn/REFERENCE.md#visualplacer) | [pawn](../assets/scripts/pawn/README.md) | Node | Places every pawn's Visual between ticks, once a frame, in one call: the "place what's drawn" pass (state store spec 12.5). |
| [VisualSmoother](../assets/scripts/pawn/REFERENCE.md#visualsmoother) | [pawn](../assets/scripts/pawn/README.md) | Node | Draws a pawn's Visual smoothly between ticks: it glides between where the body was after its last two runs, turns the model the same way, and fades network corrections out. |
| [WaitStep](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#waitstep) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | AbilityStep | A timed pause, such as an attack's recovery: it does nothing but take its length_ticks. |
| [WalkAbility](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#walkability) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | AbilityBase | Walking on the ground: accelerating, slowing, steering in the air and turning to face where it's going. The default locomotion. |
| [WalkDefinition](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#walkdefinition) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | AbilityDefinition | Walk's settings: the default locomotion. |
| [WindupStep](../assets/scripts/abilities/REFERENCE.md#windupstep) | [abilities](../assets/scripts/abilities/README.md) | AbilityStep | The wait before an attack's hit, turning toward the look first if it needs to. |
| [WorldCoordinator](../assets/scripts/world/REFERENCE.md#worldcoordinator) | [world](../assets/scripts/world/README.md) | Node3D | Puts a level together from its parts: terrain, streaming and the nav feeder. |
| [WorldCursor](../assets/scripts/player/REFERENCE.md#worldcursor) | [player](../assets/scripts/player/README.md) | Node | What the mouse or crosshair points at in the world: a part of PlayerController. |
